query.text: 请帮我照看老人，有异常或危险情况及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after the elderly person, and alert me in time if there is any abnormal or dangerous situation.

annotation.text_zh: 您手抖得厉害，请先坐下休息。
annotation.text_en: Your hands are shaking quite a bit. Please sit down and rest.

annotation.text_zh: 您身体在摇晃，请扶好，谨防摔倒。
annotation.text_en: You're swaying a bit. Please hold onto something so you don't fall.

annotation.text_zh: 您摔倒了，请保持静止，等待救援。
annotation.text_en: You've fallen. Please stay still and wait for help.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
